title: "My knees hurt whenever I squat."
hook: "My knees hurt whenever I squat."
caption:
"My knees hurt whenever I squat."

"My back gets stiff. I don't want to make it worse."

"My shoulder hasn't been the same since surgery."

"My balance isn't what it used to be."

Maybe you've had one of those thoughts.

You know you need to become stronger and more active, but you're waiting to feel stronger and more capable before you start.

So you wait for your knee to feel better. Your back to loosen up. Your shoulder to feel normal. Your body to somehow feel "ready."

But that perfect starting point may never arrive.

By our 50s, 60s, and beyond, many of us have a history:

Old injuries.

title: Are your wants authentic or is it programming? 🗝️
hook: Are your wants authentic or is it programming? 🗝️
caption:
Are your wants authentic or is it programming? 🗝️

We spend so much of our lives chasing goals, milestones, and lifestyles that we were handed by society, family culture, and external conditioning—only to catch up to them and realize they don't even feel good.

Deconditioning means stripping away the shoulds to find out what your soul actually desires. When you stop running toward programmed markers of success, you can finally build a life aligned with your true truth.

Have you ever achieved a goal only to realize it wasn’t actually what you wanted? Share your experience below. 👇🏻
